title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18

title: Within 6 months, ChatGPT can watch your screen, meetings & emails: CEO Altman

These intuitive systems are designed to access emails, documents, and Slack messages for better context and efficiency. Users will have control over the type of information that AI can interface with, potentially transforming the workplace dynamics. Altman predicts this revolutionary capability could become available within six months.

title: Samoa's snail-control flatworms later became a threat to native snails
content: The introduction of the invasive flatworm, Platydemus manokwari, aimed at pest control, has resulted in a dramatic decline of native tree snail populations in the Pacific Islands. This aggressive predator actively hunts these snails, driving several species towards extinction. Following previous unsuccessful biological control attempts, federal data now labels these native snails as endangered or threatened, prompting strict biosecurity measures to halt the invasion of this detrimental species.

title: New Zealand introduced hedgehogs for pests; now they threaten native wildlife
content: European hedgehogs were brought to New Zealand during the 1800s to help manage garden pests. However, these spiky creatures now pose a grave danger to the country's unique wildlife. They feast on the eggs and young of various native species, significantly impacting fragile ecosystems, particularly those involving ground-nesting birds. As a result, ongoing conservation initiatives are prioritizing hedgehog removal to protect these threatened populations.

title: Zerodha CEO Nithin Kamath praises SEBI for proposed NRI investing rule change

title: Iran claims control, ships choose Omani route: What's changing in Strait of Hormuz
content: the battle for control of the Strait of Hormuz has emerged as a key focus of the Iran war . the competing claims have created uncertainty over the extent of control exercised by either side over the critical waterway . however, shipping data indicates that the united states is gaining ground as its navy patrols the strait .
